n: Artificial intelligence but where is the intelligence?
t: A cs4fn lesson idea on what AI is and whether following rules counts as intelligence.
steps: Find the lesson on the Australian Digital Technologies Hub.
Open the cs4fn booklet linked from the page.
Choose one or two activities that fit your class.
Check the copying rules for your country.
Run the activity with a small group first.
End with a talk on what the class thinks intelligence means.
